about: Third-party 3D graphics card models bundled with Money Tweaks. Only licenses that explicitly allow commercial use, modification and redistribution are accepted (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-3.0, CC-BY-4.0); each license was checked on the model's page when added. Attribution is shown in Reality Lab and in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Files are bundled unmodified; the app only rotates, scales and centres them when drawing. The first matching entry is used.
